previous.description: The previous run's snapshot: the snapshot object, its JSON text, or the Google Sheets value range it was saved in (the read step's output). Empty on the first run.

audit.description: website-seo-page-audit's output. Left out on JoyStream: read from the output that step saved in this sandbox.

speed.description: website-seo-performance's output. Left out on JoyStream, as audit.

gaps.description: website-seo-content-gap's output. Left out on JoyStream, as audit.

escalate_after_checks.description: A critical or high issue still open on this many checks is flagged to act on now. Default 2: flagged the first time it is seen again.

report_url.description: A link where a person opens this run's files, such as the agent's page in JoyStream.

report_file.description: The PDF a report step makes this run, e.g. seo-report.pdf.
